title: Relationship Rate Reduction on Kestrel Advantage Balloon Refinances
content:
**Relationship pricing — refinance APR.** When the balloon of a Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract is refinanced, a customer who keeps other Kestrel accounts current has the refinance APR reduced. The lines counted are the **Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contract**, the **Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract** and the **Kestrel Closed-End Consumer Lease**; a line counts when the customer holds an active account in it showing 0 days past due.

| Lines with an active account at 0 days past due | Reduction of the refinance APR |
|---|---|
| Two or three | 0.5 percentage points |
| Exactly one | The tier's relationship rate reduction, 0.25 percentage points on every tier |
| None | None |

The records read are the status and days past due of the customer's accounts in the three lines. A customer with exactly one such current account keeps the relationship rate reduction of the balloon refinance terms schedule.

*Hypothetical:* an active lease at 0 days past due, an active pre-owned contract at 0 days past due and an active new-vehicle retail contract at 15 days past due: two lines, a reduction of 0.5 percentage points.
